minutes.headline: Committee voted to start the Comcast internet upgrade at Turkey Hill and the Primary School, and approved a primary school line transfer.
minutes.summary: Remote meeting. The committee approved a line-item transfer to cover learning-software subscriptions at the primary school, the minutes, the FY20 end-of-year financial report, and the Comcast bandwidth upgrade for the two buildings. It waived first reads of a batch of policies, and heard a new COVID dashboard presentation, a teachers' union president's comment, and subcommittee reports.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 5-0 to start the Comcast internet upgrade at Turkey Hill and the Primary School.
The committee voted 5-0 to accept a line-item transfer covering learning-software subscriptions at the primary school.
The committee voted 5-0 to approve the FY20 end-of-year financial report as presented; it is to be posted on the district website.
The committee voted 5-0 to waive the first reading of the policies brought before it; they are to be posted on the committee page.
The IT director is to update the committee on Comcast scheduling on December 2nd, when a winter sports update is also expected.

why_it_matters: The upgrade targets internet failures at two school buildings during remote and hybrid teaching, and E-rate funding that becomes available in January depends on the district proceeding.
The transfer shows learning-software subscriptions at the primary school running past their budget lines, paid by moving money from furniture, equipment and math supplies lines.
The committee heard that CARES grant money is paying for teacher technology, and that some CARES money on the town side could go unspent by December 31st.
